text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of the NHK Mile
Championship, and
Seeking the Pearl
seems to be feeling off, just like
she did
on the day of the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It's the opposite of what I felt during the
Oka
Sho. I feel familiarity... and a strong
sense of
sympathy...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I think the NHK Mile Championship is
my
promised race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, I feel like it's bound to my soul. It
just
feels... right.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is good! Very good! I have a feeling
I'll be
able to show off some undeniably
excellent
running today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems this strange sensation has
brought
Seeking the Pearl some kind of
clarity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm still not sure what to make of it, but
I'm just
glad she's feeling so positive.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this NHK Mile Championship is
the
prelude that will bring me the
spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run fabulously, and then
export
myself right out onto the
international stage!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
choice_data_list: Yeah, a 1,600m left-handed course is your best fit.
Yeah, 1,600m counterclockwise is her best track, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's just what I've personally observed as
her
trainer, but she seems to run a little
more
smoothly in left-handed races.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I never really thought about it
before, but I
think you might be right. I
do get a little more in
the groove with
left-handed races.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Things are looking fantastic, then! The
distance
and race direction are perfect
matches for me,
and my destiny lies
vividly before my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And I'm going to prove it in front of this
massive
crowd!
